'''Sinus Flies''' were a species that were introduced to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during an attempt to salvage the ruins of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]].<ref name="Travel Guide">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>
